items.label: Chicony Power press release: Chicony Power Reports September 2026 Consolidated Revenue (10-05-2026)

set.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (company release): consolidated sales of NT$2,413 million, down 2.3% MoM and down 20.98% YoY (NT$2,413,451 thousand versus NT$3,054,108 thousand in September 2025). Accumulated revenue for the first nine months NT$23,641 million (NT$23,641,068 thousand), down 11.15% YoY.

items.reason: The release never says 'unaudited'; that word is added by the enricher. Removed; everything else matches the release.
items.evidence: Chicony Power Technology Co., Ltd. (6412.TW) announced consolidated September sales of NT$2,413 million, down 2.3% MoM.
